children: BlackBerry announced a historic QNX design win with Coretura that adds over $100 million to QNX royalty backlog.
Coretura selected Alloy Kore, the joint QNX-Vector vehicle OS, as its safety-certified foundational software layer.
The design win is the largest in QNX history and adds more than $100 million to QNX royalty backlog.
QNX royalty backlog reflects estimated future variable royalty revenue based on rates and projected volumes.
Recognized revenue depends on production volumes and potential contract changes; backlog may not equal actual future revenue.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: BlackBerry and Vector secure largest-ever QNX design win as Coretura selects Alloy Kore
